ev.q: National opioid use disorder rates at delivery more than quadrupled during 1999–2014.
Annual prevalence of opioid use disorder per 1,000 delivery hospitalizations during 1999–2014 was calculated nationally using NIS.
In 2014, rates ranged from 0.7 (District of Columbia) to 48.6 (Vermont).
